I'm not sure if it's resolved though. cc <@586161934425128960> Nico’s config fixed the issue for me, not sure why tho, it’s practically the same. ```yaml participants_matrix: el: - el_type: reth el_image: sibkatya/reth:focil-0e41c92 # - el_type: geth # el_image: jihoonsg/geth-focil:1a1adcd cl: - cl_type: lodestar cl_image: local/lodestar:focil supernode: true count: 2 network_params: genesis_delay: 20 electra_fork_epoch: 0 fulu_fork_epoch: 0 eip7805_fork_epoch: 1 seconds_per_slot: 6 num_validator_keys_per_node: 256 snooper_enabled: true additional_services: - dora - tx_fuzz - spamoor - prometheus_grafana port_publisher: additional_services: enabled: true public_port_start: 65500 spamoor_params: spammers: - scenario: eoatx config: throughput: 100 - scenario: uniswap-swaps config: throughput: 100 - scenario: blob-combined config: throughput: 5 global_log_level: info ``` Which image is up-to-date? `local/lodestar:focil` or `ethpandaops/lodestar:focil-eb033fd`? Eb03fd is slightly out of date. Id recommend building local since the repo has a full working impl of Lodestar with the new spec and is working with Reth with no missed blocks. Reth also has a small fix so you will need to rebuild If you are testing with Reth. I am running your config with the older image so far it works but that one doesn't properly pass ILs to the execution client yet, make sure to use `ethpandaops/lodestar:focil-837cbb3` I just ran it with `837cbb3` and it gave me this: ``` [cl-1-lodestar-geth] Oct-01 19:01:56.661[network] warn: Error processing block slot=25, peer=16Uiu2HAmSuf5RZsQjixNzQD2RZEJnh8kmBrnbiAo9YJib2Um7Yos, blockRoot=0x8c7e…2651, code=BLOCK_ERROR_BEACON_CHAIN_ERROR, error=Timeout [cl-1-lodestar-geth] Error: Timeout [cl-1-lodestar-geth] at timeoutPromise (file:///usr/app/packages/utils/src/timeout.ts:19:11) [cl-1-lodestar-geth] at withTimeout (file:///usr/app/packages/utils/src/timeout.ts:23:12) [cl-1-lodestar-geth] at async Promise.all (index 0) [cl-1-lodestar-geth] at verifyBlocksDataAvailability (file:///usr/app/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/verifyBlocksDataAvailability.ts:28:3) [cl-1-lodestar-geth] at async Promise.all (index 1) [cl-1-lodestar-geth] at BeaconChain.verifyBlocksInEpoch (file:///usr/app/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/verifyBlock.ts:101:9) [cl-1-lodestar-geth] at BeaconChain.processBlocks (file:///usr/app/packages/beacon-node/src/chain/blocks/index.ts:76:7) [cl-1-lodestar-geth] at JobItemQueue.runJob (file:///usr/app/packages/beacon-node/src/util/queue/itemQueue.ts:102:22) ``` yeah saw that too, for some reason geth doesn't respond for 12 seconds to new payload, so we timeout the request haven't seen `BLOCK_ERROR_INVALID_SIGNATURE` so far hmm.. let me take a look into it tmrw curious, what was the cause? ok I just ran the same config for a 3rd time and got `BLOCK_ERROR_INVALID_SIGNATURE` at slot 32, not sure what's causing that and why it's not happening all the time alright, I'm about to hit the sack but will take a look into these tmrw. please share if you find anything in the meantime haven't been able to figure this out, it's likely not even related to our focil changes but seems related to delayed / rejected blocks (due to IL not satisfied) at fork boundary and we might calculate wrong domain to verify the signature, need to dig more tomorrow

excerpts.author: pellekrab
excerpts.content:
Nico’s config fixed the issue for me, not sure why tho, it’s practically the same.
```yaml
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: reth
      el_image: sibkatya/reth:focil-0e41c92
    # - el_type: geth
    #   el_image: jihoonsg/geth-focil:1a1adcd
  cl:
    - cl_type: lodestar
      cl_image: local/lodestar:focil
      supernode: true
      count: 2
network_params:
  genesis_delay: 20
  electra_fork_epoch: 0
  fulu_fork_epoch: 0
  eip7805_fork_epoch: 1
  seconds_per_slot: 6
  num_validator_keys_per_node: 256
snooper_enabled: true
additional_services:
  - dora
  - tx_fuzz
  - spamoor
  - prometheus_grafana
port_publisher:
  additional_services:
    enabled: true
    public_port_start: 65500
spamoor_params:
  spammers:
    - scenario: eoatx
      config:
        throughput: 100
    - scenario: uniswap-swaps
      config:
        throughput: 100
    - scenario: blob-combined
      config:
        throughput: 5
global_log_level: info
```
